mostWorthwhile.text: The quiet laboratory ending was most worthwhile: the folded limbs and the silence let the discovery register without explaining more than the story shows.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final board felt redundant because the departure and specimen transfer had already been described, and there were no goals or actions left.

surprise.text: The story ends in the receiving laboratory, with another person seeing the folded limbs, rather than offering a conclusion about what they are.

arbitrary.text: There were no gameplay actions in this chapter to judge.

continue.text: I would be curious to continue and learn what the laboratory finds, though this final chapter offered no decisions to assess as gameplay.
